checkout_opt_in.email_label: Email me with news and offers
checkout_opt_in.sms_label: Text me with news and offers
checkout_opt_in.finding: Both labels are Shopify's defaults and say nothing about what the buyer gets.

consent_scope: EU and UK visitors are 2.1% of sessions, under 5%: the unticked opt-in rule is noted, not graded. This is a check of the forms, not legal advice.

top_fixes.do: Replace the SMS step's disclosure on the welcome popup (both versions) with the full block in the variants.
top_fixes.evidence: SMS disclosure missing: message and data rates may apply; how often messages come; reply HELP for help; consent is not a condition of purchase; link to SMS terms; link to the privacy policy.
top_fixes.who: Do this in Klaviyo (form editor). Not legal advice: confirm with your counsel.

top_fixes.do: Build a delivery flow on the Brewing Guide list that emails the guide at once, then set it live.
top_fixes.evidence: 690 people signed up for the guide in 30 days (Exit flyout: brewing guide 310, Blog embed: brewing guide 380). No list-triggered flow is matched to Brewing Guide, so none of them got it.
top_fixes.who: Build it in Klaviyo; once you have reviewed it, I can set it live.

top_fixes.do: Set the reviewed SMS welcome flow live.
top_fixes.evidence: SMS welcome is draft with 0 recipients while the SMS segment added 380 people in the last 30 days; the popup promises them the code by text.
top_fixes.who: I can do this now, after your yes.

top_fixes.do: Move the mobile welcome form off on-load: a bottom flyout after 40% scroll or on the second page.
top_fixes.evidence: Shown on load to 51,500 phones; close rate 95.9% vs 76.0% on desktop; submit rate 2.04% vs 6.35%. Ceiling: 2,220 missed sign-ups a month.

top_fixes.do: Rewrite the footer form around the brewing guide.
top_fixes.evidence: Submit rate 0.75% on 12,800 views vs 7.04% for the blog embed. Ceiling: 805 missed sign-ups a month. The offer says nothing ("Newsletter" / "Sign up for news and updates.").

top_fixes.do: Add a mobile version of the brewing guide flyout on collection and product pages.
top_fixes.evidence: Mobile collection and product pages hold 36,800 sessions (34.1% of site sessions without cart and checkout) and see only the sitewide popup and the footer. Estimate: about 659 sign-ups a month at the exit flyout's 17.9 per 1,000 sessions on the same pages.

top_fixes.do: Change the checkout box labels to say what buyers get.
top_fixes.evidence: 19.0% of 1,420 new buyers opted in to email and 2.5% to SMS. Each extra 10 points adds about 142 subscribers a month.
top_fixes.who: Do this in Shopify (checkout language settings).
